basic_info.description: Come see the bay views from this stunning, bright, and expansive top-floor Dogpatch home! This large  3 bedroom/3 full bathroom property at Millwheel North has it all. The unit is located on the south  end of the top floor of the building allowing for privacy and multiple skylights throughout. Two primary suites  with walk-in closets and en-suite bathrooms flank the central third bedroom. All closets are built out  with flexible Elfa systems. The open kitchen/living/dining area has beautiful wood flooring, a cozy gas fireplace, and bay views. The updated kitchen has stainless appliances (Bertazzoni gas range), quartz counters, and classic white cabinetry. The property includes in-unit laundry closet, an extremely large storage room and 1-car parking on the lobby level (2nd parking space available for lease). The building has a sunny center courtyard for dining and lounging, bike storage, and an elevator. Millwheel North is located across the street from Progress Park with easy access to Caltrain, 280, 3rd Street Muni, etc. - a commuter's dream!
